text: My soul [as well as my body] is greatly dismayed. But as for You, O LORD—how long [until You act on my behalf]?
For in death there is no mention of You; In Sheol (the nether world, the place of the dead) who will praise You and give You thanks?
My eye grows dim with grief; It grows old because of all my enemies.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly horrified; Let them turn back, let them suddenly be ashamed [of what they have done].
